row.evidence: 15Five's help centre documents SCIM 2.0 provisioning for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace and OneLogin, but neither the pricing page (Engage $4, Perform $11, Total Platform $16 per user per month billed annually) nor the docs say which plan includes SCIM.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to unknown: the June row's 'SCIM gated to Perform tier and above' has no first-party source; the current pricing page does not mention SCIM or SSO and no help-centre article names a SCIM plan, so the Perform gate was dropped. 15Five's security page says SSO 'is included with some plans or can be purchased as an add-on for others' and that security logs are 'only accessible on some plans'. JumpCloud's integration page still lists a legacy '15Five Plus Plan' plus an SSO add-on as prerequisites, which does not map to today's Engage/Perform/Total Platform tiers. Prices unchanged from June (Engage $4, Perform $11, Total Platform $16 per user/mo billed annually). SSO is recommended before SCIM but the two are configured independently.

plans.name: Total Platform
plans.notes: Pricing page lists add-ons (manager Content $49/manager/mo, Coaching $399/credit, Kona Meeting Assistant $2/employee/mo, Kona Coach $19/manager/mo, Compensation $9 and $11/u/mo). No tier lists SSO or SCIM.

scim.notes: SSO is recommended to be set up first (c16) but SCIM and SSO are configured independently (c8).

auth.token_source: Settings > Integrations > SCIM 2.0 > Enable > Generate OAuth token (30-character token; Account Admin with Manage integrations)

operations.notes: Updates are documented (profile sync) but the HTTP method (PUT vs PATCH) is not. Delete is configurable in OneLogin and Google Workspace (hard delete); Okta and Azure deactivate.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users move to the Deactivated tab and lose access; data is kept on the backend and restores on reactivation, though most of it is no longer visible in the UI. The seat becomes unoccupied and is reused by the next new person, but there is no refund or credit for the rest of the subscription. An optional setting reassigns a deactivated manager's direct reports to their manager.

custom.how: 15Five extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:15Five:2.0:User carries location, startDate, hireDate, terminationDate and custom attributes (Okta variable names prefixed with custom).

limitations.text: Timezone does not sync via SCIM.
When SCIM is enabled, manual user creation in Manage People is disabled; CSV import must be re-enabled by 15Five Support.
Only group ID, name and members sync; other group attributes do not transfer.
Users managed by SCIM must be deactivated or reactivated through the IdP; changes made in 15Five can be reversed by the next sync.
JIT provisioning must stay off when SCIM is used, or duplicate accounts are created.

user_api.notes: Public API is enabled under Settings > Integrations > Public API by an Account Admin; no plan restriction is documented.

auth.notes: API key passed as the HTTP Basic username (also shown as an Authorization header). 32-character keys expire after 1 year; a key can be limited to High Fives only.

endpoints.purpose: Create or update users in bulk
Upload a bulk user import (CSV) file

audit_log_api.notes: Security page says security logs are only accessible on some plans; which plans is not stated.

rate_limits.text: 5 requests per second; limits are per server per IP address, not per account.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM and Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password, Group Push, Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

onelogin.notes: From 15Five's own OneLogin guide (OneLogin connector page not loaded, bots blocked).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS Connector (BambooHR, Rippling, Justworks, ADP and others), Gusto, SFTP, Public API bulk import
